content: axum 0.8.9 (2026-04-14, latest; no 0.9 release). Two listeners = two tokio TcpListener + axum::serve(...).with_graceful_shutdown joined via tokio::try_join. SSE via axum::response::sse::{Sse,Event,KeepAlive}; raw passthrough via Body::from_stream. DefaultBodyLimit 2MB must be raised for AI payloads. tower-http 0.7.1 (2026-08-31) adds CsrfLayer (Sec-Fetch-Site based), DeadlineBody, on-early-drop middleware.
